description: registro_004 step 53, episode 90589108 vs Marnie (WON suboptimally). A STERILE turn: an active Dipplin at 50/80 with one Grass chips a 320 HP Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex at full health that knocks it out next turn, the bench holds no charged body, the Dipplin cannot pay its own retreat (cost 2, one energy) and the Supporter slot is free with three Lillie's Determination alive in the deck. The agent ATTACKED and closed the turn; the second Meowth ex goes down FIRST (Last-Ditch Catch -> Lillie's) and the attack still closes the turn -- with one more benched body behind 'Do the Wave'. Four counterfactuals, one per guard.
